 FDA Announces Nationwide Recall of Popular Toothpastes—Here’s Everything You Need to Know 
 Follow Beauty & Personal Care Products View feed FDA Announces Nationwide Recall of Popular Toothpastes—Here’s Everything You Need to Know 
 The Class II recall covers 17 toothpaste varieties.
 By Lisa Mulcahy Published: Oct 22, 2026 9:41 AM EDT Save Article Share Article 1 Getty Images On October 19, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) issued an enforcement report announcing 17 Class II nationwide recalls of adults’ and kids’ toothpaste. The toothpaste was manufactured by Pritam International Private Limited and distributed in the U.S. by Ashtel Studios Inc. Pritam initiated the voluntary recall on September 10 for 4,301,700 tubes.
 The FDA states that the reason for the recalls is Current Good Manufacturing Practice (CGMP) deviations . While specific details weren’t provided by the agency, CGMP regulations ensure that products—like anticavity toothpaste, which are regulated like OTC drugs—are made correctly and consistently.
 A Class II recall means that if you’re exposed to or use a product, you could experience temporary or medically treatable adverse health problems, or that serious adverse health issues are unlikely. The enforcement report didn’t include any information as to whether any illnesses have been reported as linked to the recall.
 Recalled products 
 There are a number of varieties of toothpaste being recalled, including popular kids’ toothpastes with characters like Barbie, Hot Wheels, Crayola Silly Scents, and My Little Pony. Adult toothpaste varieties include whitening, sensitivity, cavity-protection, and gum health formulas.
 Check the toothpaste you have against the following list of recalled products, and check the FDA’s full list of affected products, including UPCs, lot numbers, and expiration dates.

 Brush Buddies Hot Wheels Anticavity Toothpaste, Strawberry, 4 oz 
 Brush Buddies Crayola Silly Scents Anticavity Toothpaste, Bubble Gum, 4 oz 
 Brush Buddies Crayola Silly Scents Anticavity Toothpaste, Watermelon, 4 oz 
 Brush Buddies Crayola Silly Scents Anticavity Toothpaste, Strawberry, 4 oz

 evo Advanced Whitening Anticavity Toothpaste, Peppermint, 3.5 oz 
 evo Sensitive Anticavity Toothpaste, Sweet Mint, 3.5 oz 
 Brush Buddies Vanilla Ice Cream Anticavity Toothpaste, 3.5 oz 
 Brush Buddies Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream Anticavity Toothpaste, 3.5 oz 
 Brush Buddies Cookies ’n Cream Ice Cream Anticavity Toothpaste, 3.5 oz 
 Brush Buddies Chocolate Ice Cream Anticavity Toothpaste, 3.5 oz 
 Brush Buddies Whitening Anticavity Toothpaste with Baking Soda, Cool Mint, 3.5 oz 
 Brush Buddies Cavity Protection Anticavity Toothpaste, Cool Mint, two 3.5 oz tubes 
 Brush Buddies Advanced Whitening Anticavity Toothpaste, Peppermint, 3.5 oz
 ARU Gum Health Toothpaste, Soothing Mint, 3.5 oz 
 ARU Cavity Protection Toothpaste, Cool Mint, 3.5 oz
 What to do if you have any of the recalled products 
 The FDA hasn’t provided any specific instructions regarding what to do with the products, but because they are part of a recall, it’s safest to stop using them. You should contact the retailer or manufacturer for information regarding refunds.
